ev.q: The original shooter-looter returns, packing bazillions of guns
infinitely more guns to shoot that have never felt this good to hold
each with unique abilities, playstyles, deep skill trees
Play solo or join with friends
Guns that grow legs and chase down enemies
Came for the story, stayed for the 47 guns I absolutely did not need
with even vaster worlds to explore and adventure through
that have never felt this good to hold
the gameplay is quite repetetive and feels like a chore at times
Every single quest has at least two-thirds of its objectives
in the first few hours, most of the game is spent standing around waiting for characters
The story is far too long yet at the same time nearly devoid of anything noteworthy
